69061-12-50591.label_basis: SDS reports ocular effects clearing within 17 days; consistent with source positive binary label. Exact II vs earlier clearance cannot be independently reconstructed without the study time series.
69061-12-50591.issue: SDS header also lists CAS 51-03-6 and 113-48-4; amounts are not supplied in the extracted composition. Do not copy amounts from another brand. No resolved input in source CSV.

1021-1723-12281.label_basis: Manufacturer SDS indexed text states rabbit irritation clearing in 21 days, consistent with EPA II.
1021-1723-12281.source_page: Manufacturer SDS search-index text; full PDF open failed
1021-1723-12281.issue: Manufacturer ingredient sheet calls 0.300% PBO technical: 0.240% main ether plus 0.060% related compounds. Source CSV represents the full nominal amount by one structure; retained as an explicit source approximation.

270-324.label_basis: SDS section 15 reproduces the FIFRA eye-specific temporary-injury statement supporting EPA II; not inferred from the general WARNING word.
270-324.issue: Only three resolved ingredients; UVCB surfactants and balance missing from molecular representation.

2724-485.label_basis: SDS FIFRA eye-specific moderate-irritation statement supports EPA III. This strengthens the source CSV rationale, which relied on GHS 2B and CAUTION.
2724-485.issue: Same primary registration family as Adams Plus 2724-485-270; not two independent products for pooled inference.

2724-485-270.label_basis: SDS section 15 reproduces the FIFRA eye-specific moderate-irritation statement supporting EPA III; not based on GHS translation alone.
2724-485-270.issue: Same primary registration family as Zodiac 2724-485. SDS alcohol ranges differ, so keep both variants and average within family only for descriptive grouped metrics.

151-21-3.issue: CAS denotes sodium lauryl sulfate, but supplied SMILES is neutral alkyl sulfuric acid without sodium. Exclude this row from molecular-label comparison until corrected from a verified structure source.

122-99-6.issue: SCCS original report still shows slight corneal opacity in one animal on day 15; full recovery by day 15 is not established. EPA I vs II is unresolved, but persistence beyond day 7 supports the merged I/II positive endpoint.

56-81-5.issue: CIR supports nonirritating rabbit glycerin tests up to 100%, but the CSV aggregates studies without a unique underlying study identifier.

cir.general: Other CIR entries are repository-extracted labels, not all independently readjudicated. Diluted ingredients lack complete vehicles; multiple concentrations/rinsing conditions of one CAS cannot be treated as independent chemicals. A Draize score or mild/moderate adjective alone does not establish EPA recovery-time category.

zein: The supplied CSV contains a zein protein-solubilization endpoint. It is not an EPA eye reference label and is excluded from all eye metrics.
